description: Compare projected cost of renting vs buying a home over a holding period, anchored to LIVE market mortgage rates. Given home price, down payment, monthly rent, and a holding period, returns year-by-year cumulative cost of each path (rent vs PITI), equity built, net cost of owning after sale, and the breakeven year where buying becomes cheaper than renting. If no rate is supplied, the current best market rate for the state is used. Use for 'should I rent or buy?' questions.

annual_insurance.description: Homeowners insurance in dollars/year. Default max(800, 0.35% of home price).

closing_cost_pct.description: Buying closing costs as % of home price. Default 3.0.

down_payment.description: Cash down payment in dollars. Default 20% of home_price.

holding_period_years.description: How many years you plan to own. Default 7.

investment_return_rate.description: Opportunity cost return on invested savings as %. Default 5.0.

maintenance_rate.description: Annual maintenance as % of home value. Default 1.0.

marginal_tax_rate.description: Marginal tax rate as %, used to model mortgage-interest/property-tax deduction. Default 0 (no deduction).

monthly_rent.description: Current monthly rent in dollars. Required.

pmi_rate.description: Annual PMI as % of loan balance. Default 0.5, applied only when LTV > 80%.

property_tax_rate.description: Annual property tax as % of home value. Default 1.1.

rate.description: Annual interest rate, e.g. 6.5. If omitted, best market rate for the state is used.

selling_cost_pct.description: Selling costs as % of sale price. Default 6.0.

state.description: 2-letter US state code for the market-rate lookup. Default CA.

name: analyze_rent_vs_buy

assumed_defaults.description: Every input that was defaulted rather than supplied. Rent-vs-buy swings hard on these, so surface them.

field.description: Name of the defaulted input, e.g. 'rate', 'property_tax_rate', 'annual_insurance'.

reason.description: Why that value was chosen, e.g. resolved from live market data for the state or a national default.

value.description: Value used for that input, formatted as a percent or dollar string.

breakeven.description: When buying overtakes renting on the assumptions used.

months.description: The same crossover expressed in months from the start.

note.description: Plain-English statement of the crossover and whether it falls inside the modeled horizon.

year.description: Year in which buying becomes cheaper than renting. Null when it never does within the horizon.

buy.description: The full economics of buying over the holding period.

monthly_breakdown.description: The monthly cost split into principal_interest, tax, insurance, pmi, hoa, and maintenance, each in dollars.

monthly_piti.description: Total monthly housing cost in dollars when buying: principal, interest, taxes, insurance, plus PMI, HOA, and maintenance where modeled.

net_cost_after_equity.description: True cost of owning in dollars: total paid less the proceeds recovered at sale. This is the figure to compare with renting.

net_proceeds_at_sale.description: Cash in dollars left after selling at the end of the period and paying off the loan and selling costs.

total_cost_over_period.description: All dollars paid out while owning over the holding period, including the down payment and monthly costs.

year_by_year.description: One entry per year of the holding period, tracking equity, home value, loan balance, and cumulative cost in dollars.

year_by_year_truncated_from.description: Full number of years modeled before the array above was shortened for display. Null when nothing was omitted.

confidence.description: Qualitative confidence in the recommendation — 'high' when the margin is wide relative to the assumptions.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

rate_used.description: Mortgage rate in percent used for the buy path (6 = 6.00%). Check rate_source to see whether it was supplied or resolved from live market data.

recommendation.description: Which path the model favors on these assumptions: 'buy' or 'rent'.

rent.description: The full economics of renting over the same holding period.

opportunity_value_of_invested_savings.description: Dollars the renter is assumed to accumulate by investing the down payment and any monthly difference — this is credited to the rent side.

starting_monthly_rent.description: Monthly rent in dollars at the start of the period, before the assumed annual increases.

total_cost_over_period.description: All rent paid in dollars over the holding period.

year_by_year.description: One entry per year, with the annual rent and cumulative cost in dollars as rent escalates.

year_by_year_truncated_from.description: Full number of years modeled before the array above was shortened. Null when nothing was omitted.

summary_note.description: One-sentence bottom line with the dollar gap between the two paths, safe to quote.
